query:
SELECT m.id, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeId, m.attendeeNumber, s.companyName
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId = '195183358360' AND s.companyName LIKE '%Appcast%'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
